title: Sales & CS Rehearsal Kits — Scenario Matrix, Scripted Rebuttals, and Demo Validation Checklist
creator: Avery Collins
description: Create a compact, practice-oriented enablement bundle for Sales and Customer Success ahead of the runtime-1.20 public rollout. The package focuses on live-rehearsal scenarios, a prioritized matrix of buyer objections and recommended rebuttals, a short demo validation checklist for engineers to sign off on demo reliability, and an at-a-glance quick reference for field teams to use during customer conversations.
deliverables: Rehearsal scenario matrix (25 scenarios: PS, Enterprise, FinServ, Low-latency mobile)
Scripted rebuttals doc with decision tree (top 12 objections)
Demo validation checklist (engineer sign-off + smoke tests)
One-page quick reference for SDRs and BDRs
Recorded demo golden run (3-4 minutes) with timestamps and known failure modes
acceptance_criteria: Sales & CS have run at least two rehearsal sessions with product present
Demo validation checklist signed by 2 runtime engineers and 1 reliability engineer
Rebuttals doc reviewed and approved by Legal for claims language
Assets uploaded to Confluence and linked from the launch playbook
At least one field rep reports 'ready' in post-rehearsal survey (>=4/5)
tasks: Draft scenario matrix and map to customer archetypes (owner: Rohan)
Work with Eng on reproducible demo scripts and add smoke test commands (owner: Priya Desai)
Write concise rebuttals and escalate any unverifiable claims to Legal (owner: Avery)
Produce the facilitator slide deck and rehearsal runbook (owner: Marisol)
Schedule two mandatory rehearsal slots for Sales & CS in the week before GA (owner: GTM ops)
Record golden-run demo and create trimmed clip for sales intro (owner: Video team)
Localize one-page quick ref for EMEA (owner: Localization)
Coordinate with Docs to include demo smoke-test commands in release notes section (owner: Docs)
Add checklist gating to release checklist so demo sign-off is required before customer-facing demos (owner: Release Manager)
